The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.

The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. title: Manager – Revenue (Kochi)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Delivery Manager**

Client Delivery & Operations • Digital Marketing

**Purpose of the Role**

Ensemble delivers digital marketing and AI services to a growing base of clinical and healthcare clients. The Delivery Manager owns the system that keeps that growth running smoothly — making on-time, on-scope delivery the standard across every account by owning intake, planning, capacity, cadence, and quality end to end.

This is a dedicated operations role focused on one outcome: consistent, reliable delivery. It is the foundation that lets clients trust us with more work and lets the team do its best work without friction.

**Reporting**

**Reports to:**
COO / Managing Director

**Works with:**
Account leads, the offshore (India) delivery team, and specialists across SEO, Paid Ads, Creative, Video, Web Development, Content, and AI.

**Core Responsibilities**
**1. Own on-time delivery across all accounts**

•  Hold end-to-end accountability for every client deliverable shipping on time and to standard.

•  Maintain one live view of all work in flight — status, owner, due date, and risk — so nothing stays invisible until it is already late.

**2. Plan capacity and resources**

•  Forecast team capacity against committed work and flag over-allocation
**before**
it causes slippage.

•  Balance workload across the offshore team and specialists; reassign to clear bottlenecks.

•  Translate client commitments into realistic timelines the team can actually hit — push back when they can’t.

**3. Control intake, priorities, and scope**

•  Run a disciplined intake process — no work starts without a clear scope, owner, and deadline.

•  Set and communicate priorities across accounts; resolve conflicts between competing client demands.

•  Catch scope creep early and escalate the trade-off rather than silently absorbing it into the timeline.

**4. Run the delivery cadence**

•  Lead a recurring delivery rhythm (daily standup + weekly account review) that surfaces risk early.

•  Coordinate across time zones so the offshore team stays unblocked and handoffs don’t stall overnight.

•  Track dependencies and escalations and drive them to resolution.

**5. Enforce quality**

•  Review deliverables before they reach the client — nothing ships below standard.

•  For healthcare and clinical clients, ensure work meets compliance expectations (HIPAA-aware handling, compliant tracking and reporting).

•  Reduce rework by catching issues internally, not at the client.

**6. Report to clients and leadership**

•  Give clients clear, consistent status updates — progress, what’s next, and any risks to the timeline.

•  Give leadership an honest, data-backed view of delivery health and where it is at risk.

**7. Build the delivery system**

•  Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, and workflows so delivery is predictable, not heroic.

•  Continuously remove recurring blockers and improve throughput without simply adding headcount.

•  Mentor coordinators and the offshore team toward accountability and ownership.

**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)**

Delivery health is measured, reviewed monthly, and owned by this role:

**Metric Target**

1. On-time delivery rate ≥ 95% of deliverables shipped by the committed date
2. Rework rate < 10% of deliverables needing rework after internal review
3. Client-reported quality issues Trending down quarter over quarter
4. Team utilization 75–85% (productive, not overloaded or idle)
5. SLA / turnaround compliance ≥ 95% of requests handled within agreed timeframes
6. Delivery visibility 100% of active work tracked in one live source of truth
7. Escalation handling Risks flagged and resolved before the deadline, not after

**Qualifications**

•  Minimum 5+ years in project or delivery management, ideally in a digital or creative agency.

•  Proven track record improving or scaling on-time delivery across multiple concurrent accounts.

•  Working knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social, creative and video production, web development, content, and analytics — enough to judge quality and timelines, and to execute hands-on, if essential.

•  Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams across time zones.

•  Familiarity with healthcare or clinical client requirements (HIPAA awareness) is a strong plus.

•  Strong on process design, prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management.

**Ideal Candidate**

An operations leader who makes delivery boringly predictable. Organized, calm under competing deadlines, hands-on and relentless about removing blockers and building the systems that let good quality work ship on time — every account, every time.

As per market for the right fit candidate
